Redragon Griffin M607 RGB Gaming Mouse (7200 DPI)

Secure elite tracking speed and ultimate ergonomic comfort with the Redragon Griffin M607 RGB Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance wired hardware accessory is structurally engineered for competitive PC gamers who demand precision, swift handling, and stylish design in their daily desktop setup. It stands as the definitive choice for esports enthusiasts and budget-conscious hardware configurations across Egypt looking for an immediate modification to unlock seamless physical tracking.

The Redragon Griffin M607 features an advanced optical gaming sensor supporting adjustable sensitivity configurations up to 7200 DPI and a 1000Hz polling rate environment for near-zero latency layout execution. Equipped with 7 fully programmable buttons built with durable gaming switches, it delivers tactile and satisfying click management. Complete with immersive dynamic RGB backlighting running along its streamlined contour and non-slip side panels, it ensures a locked, comfortable anchor during intense action scenarios.
